walkthroughs.body_html:
Theme 2: Political and Artistic Culture in the Spanish-speaking World — a core area of A-Level Spanish.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Theme 2: Political and Artistic Culture in the Spanish-speaking World brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Theme 2: Political and Artistic Culture in the Spanish-speaking World.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: El Día de los Muertos is celebrated mainly in which country, and when?
options: Mexico, on 1-2 November
Spain, in July
Argentina, at Easter
Cuba, in January
A tomato-throwing festival held in Buñol
A flamenco competition in Seville
A Mexican harvest dance
A Spanish cooking contest on television

mcqs.q: Reggaetón has its roots in which places?
options: Panama and Puerto Rico
Madrid and Barcelona
Italy and France
Chile and Bolivia

mcqs.q: Is flamenco just a style of dance?
options: No - flamenco is a threefold art of cante (song), toque (guitar) and baile (dance), held together by the compás.
Flamenco only means the dancing with dresses and castanets.
It is a national sports holiday.
Flamenco is a Mexican mariachi style.

mcqs.q: Is el Día de los Muertos simply the Mexican version of Halloween?
options: Flamenco is a Mexican mariachi style.
It is just Halloween with different decorations.
No - it is a distinct tradition honouring deceased family members with altars, food and flowers, blending indigenous and Catholic elements.
It is a national sports holiday.

mcqs.q: Does 'una fiesta' only mean a private party?
options: No - it also means a public festival or holiday, such as las fiestas de un pueblo or una fiesta nacional.
Flamenco is a Mexican mariachi style.
Fiesta always refers to a birthday-style party.
Fiesta is a word used only for weddings.
